s00744.summary: Marguerite records a wartime report in a shelled cellar, correcting her own take.
German boots cross overhead; she douses the lamp and smothers the recorder until they leave.
She relights the lamp, records that they have gone, and writes as shells fall closer.
She finds the cellar door locked from outside and leaves a message for her newspaper.
The ceiling cracks; she gathers her reel and forces the door open with a splintered post.
She tumbles into the burning kitchen, confirms the reel is intact and walks into the firelight.

s01796.summary: Four men idle in a trading post, offering coffee in an uneasy hush.
Ezekiel questions Wiley's destination; Josiah slips and Wiley snaps at him.
Ezekiel recounts a man named Cutter who laid the black eight on the red nine, as Wiley just did.
Ezekiel produces a shotgun; the reverend reveals he is the marshal and Wiley surrenders.

s02205.summary: With the wedding at three, Corky denies that the leaning cake is a problem as others bicker.
Mrs. Crespo rolls up her sleeves and dowels the cake straight while the team holds its breath.
The cake stands perfect; Corky says he owes her his career and she demands slices.
The delivery van is broken, so Mrs. Crespo offers her large station wagon and they go.

s02382.summary: Corporal Emmeline sends a warning of approaching bombers by key while a recorder captures it.
No reply comes; the lamp goes out and Emmeline keeps tapping as the walls shake.

s01416.summary: In a court corridor Cordelia coaches Fern to stay silent while the opposing side sits across.
Marisela loudly calls Fern a liar, and both sides rise to confront each other.
Bronwen quietly asks Fern to sit down, and he does.
Called in, Fern and Bronwen stubbornly refuse to go first until Cordelia shoves them through.

s01224.summary: Three explorers film their way through a ruined house of mirrors.
A thump and an extra reflection appear; a figure steps from the mirror as the light dies.

s01348.summary: Ilse and Wynne climb a singing glass staircase toward a distant citadel.
Ilse asks if her mother returned; Wynne answers that she did not say.
Ilse tests a cracked step, and the two agree they are both followers.

s01536.summary: Tobias questions Rosie's pressure logs, and the live gauge contradicts her numbers.
Deck Two reports a rotten-egg smell; they realize it is hydrogen sulphide.
Tobias orders Deck Two to evacuate and holds the alarm, then announces an orderly muster.
The gauge plunges, Rosie pulls the alarm, and they run into the red corridor.

s00690.summary: In a cold kitchen, Hattie burns a match down while Constance and father Walter stay stiff and silent.
Hattie says their dead mother came back last night; Walter insists she is buried.
Constance tells Hattie to take the matchbox away; Walter stares at it and covers it with his hand.

s01838.summary: Teddy and Armand banter on the dock with wine while Corinne calls her to dinner.
His father questions the good shirt, and Armand says he has something to ask Teddy.

s02036.summary: Asher ice-fishes while the ranger radios warnings that the ice is thinning.
A huge catch tugs the line as a crack spreads, and Asher keeps hauling.
He lands a trout, cradles it gently, answers the radio and heads north.

s01614.summary: On a rooftop, Mo presses Gabby about her likely move to Toronto.
Si reveals he got into film school in L.A., and Mo realizes both friends are leaving.
They laugh wearily, then film the sunset and record that they were here.

s00128.summary: Coach Greer finds an elderly woman on the closed ice and demands how she got in.
Margit says the championship stone pulls left and urges him to grind it.
Greer finds a burr on the stone as Margit says it pulled left in 1961 and leaves.

s01407.summary: Madame Odile conducts a seance for widower Alistair, with a hidden gramophone as her trick.
A voice speaks as Alistair's wife, but Prudence did not make it; it tells the fraud to stop.
Odile denies being behind it as the candle blows out and a window bangs open.

s00794.summary: Prosecutor Alistair rehearses an opening to an empty jury box while Roxanne watches.
Roxanne jabs that he is nervous and mocks his opening.
She says her client is innocent; he says to prove it, and they take their tables.

s01651.summary: Branden leads an awkward team-building exercise in a decommissioned submarine.
Branden insists on a trust fall, climbs the ladder and falls as nobody catches him.

s02154.summary: Marisol plays a voice memo to her mother and cannot bring herself to open her results envelope.
She folds warm towels as if praying, places the envelope on the stack and replays the memo.

s01356.summary: Soldiers in a crater wake an enemy prisoner, and Sergeant Bell questions him.
Bell feeds the prisoner hardtack and insists on his name, Anders.
A shell lands and Anders covers the boy Hargrove's helmet, winning Bell's trust.

s00550.summary: Cleo mops the museum while curator Barnaby does his crossword and she feeds him answers.
Cleo turns the camera to the wall and begins picking the golden vault door.
Guard Enoch catches her; Cleo asks him to put the radio down and he steps aside.
The vault holds only a card reading gone fishing, answering Barnaby's crossword clue.

s02509.summary: A glittering 1961 masquerade ball of guests, servants and waltzing.
The lights fail and Lady Vera's necklace vanishes as everyone panics.
Lights return to show the necklace hanging on Colette's mask; she greets her aunt.

s01305.summary: A bolt snaps in the lunar elevator; Tamsin and Irene report a failed cable with nine minutes left.
The car steadies; they laugh with relief and drift apart still holding hands.

s01302.summary: Dorothy claims her husband was pushed and challenges everyone present.
Each of the four gives an alibi; Dorothy points out they cannot all be innocent.
Tabitha reveals the dead man called at one-forty, saying someone from this room was in the house.

s02384.summary: Dani laces up and skates alone in the closed rink while friends watch.
Mr. Lazlo storms from the booth with a bat, then charges them eight dollars each.

s01556_0.summary: Nell stands in her yard and rereads the letter her husband left from Cheyenne.
She draws water from the well and drinks, watching the empty plain.

s01393.summary: Agents press a young man to talk while their handler orders them to make him.
He names Dmitri, the pier and crates marked with a crane, and a silent woman in a red coat.
The handler names the woman in red as Margot Fenwick; Margot smiles and says oh dear.

s02362.summary: Inspector Braithwaite forbids anyone to leave the lighthouse as the suspects crowd around a body.
Dr. Oyedele says the victim has no water in his lungs; Cordelia mutters she saw nothing.
Coastguard reports no boats until dawn; Braithwaite eyes Finch and asks who was at the lamp.

s01250.summary: A stranger enters a secret card game in an undertaker's back room and sits in a coffin.
He gives his name as Nolan from Pier nine, which Bram claims as his own.
Nolan says Bram shorted forty crates and produces a receipt with Bram's signature.
Bram lunges and aims his pistol at Nolan, but Maude disarms him.
Maude proves to be the Chief and Nolan shows a full house.
